description: Upgrade any Pulumi provider to a newer version and reconcile the resulting diff. Use when users want to upgrade or update a provider (including editing package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, go.mod, or Pulumi.yaml to bump a provider SDK), check for breaking changes before or during an upgrade, fix resources that broke after a provider upgrade, or resolve unexpected replacements, creates, or deletes in a post-upgrade preview. Applies to all providers (aws, azure-native, gcp, kubernetes, aws-native, cloudflare, datadog, etc.) — not just Tier 1. Do NOT use for querying which stacks use what package versions; use skill `package-usage` for cross-stack audits. Do NOT use for general infrastructure tasks.
